name: presence
title: Presence
description: You are not alone: how many people are here, and which of them the host can name. The count rides `data-gs-value` and the named people are each an `identity`, so the avatar cases, the presence dot and the accessible name are decided in one place rather than again here. Names are the host's to give, with its players' consent, and a name is never inferred from a count. Not knowing the number is distinct from nobody being here: the number is left out rather than rendered as a nought, while a genuinely empty room carries `data-gs-empty="true"` and a designed line. Subscribes to nothing: no socket, no polling, no counting. The host knows who is here and hands it over.
docs: Pass `count` for the number of people in the room and re-render with a new one as it moves; leave it out where you only know who is here, and pass `count={0}` to say the room is empty. Pass `format` to group the thousands: `data-gs-value` keeps the raw number, so a test never parses a separator. Pass `entries` for the people you may name, each with the adapter's player and their presence, and set `you` on the player holding the device. Children render beside the count and stay announced, which is where an invite control goes; this component never opens a share sheet itself. Pass `emptyLabel` to say something about your own game to the first arrival; the accessible name keeps the contract's "nothing here yet" whatever the copy says.
